summary: Preparation is ready for the authorized submission. No blocking findings identified. The screen isolates 16/64 MiB bounce-buffer size within two fixed worker/batch profiles, retains four diagnostic pilots before eight untraced full runs, and preserves the established acceptance gates.
checks: Verified the clean detached harness checkout at the reviewed SHA and the clean pinned PR checkout at 67c327a148a08b2aaf972e67e1e02e367c2b298f. Reviewed all 26 added files; no framework changes are included.

Confirmed the four configurations, forward/reverse repeats, 810000 total events, one GPU and one CUDA stream per BD, 17/34 physical-core bindings, 36-core request, 160G host-memory request and 90-minute allocation limit.

Traced bounce-size propagation from the per-case environment to KvikIO defaults and recorded effective settings. Task size remains fixed at 1 MiB, conflicting reader overrides are rejected, and effective defaults are checked again after the loop.

Inspected the installed KvikIO defaults implementation, reusable buffer-pool header and synchronous POSIX device staging loop. The source supports the documented buffer-demand estimate and expected unchanged chunking for sub-MiB requests.

Verified that host-memory snapshots are recorded for every rank, missing or inconsistent evidence fails validation, and a barrier places post-loop observations outside the root timing and NIC bracket. Documentation distinguishes process RSS/high-water and kernel counters from exact CUDA pinned-memory usage.

Confirmed pilot-only payload-filtered strace, CPU binding of tracer and child, exact payload coverage, raw-trace hashes and independent histogram recomputation. Full runs bypass the wrapper and require TracerPid zero.

Inspected retained timestamp/read/byte/callback accounting, source and binary identity, CPU affinity, aggregate GPU headroom, drained ownership, cold-cache, physical-NIC and owner-scoped cleanup gates.
Read the coordinator's final host-test log showing 63 passed in 21.94 seconds, including real local strace and procfs checks. Inspected the associated rejection tests and validation record.

Read the passing native-compatibility receipt covering 225 native sources, 28 binaries and eight KvikIO identities, the successful scheduler test-only receipt, and the frozen submission receipt showing submitted=false.
limitations: Review used local read-only inspection. The reviewer did not run tests, scheduler operations or network calls.
Native GPU tests, CUDA execution under strace, actual host-memory observations and FFB/cache/NIC acceptance remain allocation-time gates.
Buffer demand is a source-based planning estimate. RSS, VmHWM, VmLck and VmPin do not provide an exact KvikIO pinned-memory allocation count or a total process-memory bound.
POSIX traces do not directly measure H2D timing, native task counts or bounce-buffer allocation counts. Traced pilot rates must remain excluded from throughput comparisons.
The inherited staging-copy-thread termination-grace limitation and the pilot wall-clock-window assumption remain documented.
The 90-minute limit is an execution envelope, not a completion guarantee. Two full repeats support screening comparisons, not confidence intervals or proof of a universal optimum.
